## {.q-title}

![](../logo.png){.q-logo fig-alt="Askurious"}

[/ɑːˈskjʊə.ri.əs/, from **ask** and **curious**]{.q-ipa}

[Surveys for research: design, field, analyse, share.]{.q-claim}

[Askurious.de · see it live at Askurious.de/s/introduction]{.muted .small}

## The vision {.center}

::: {.q-grid style="--cols: 2;"}
::: {.q-card .big}
[Open source]{.q-h}
Research infrastructure that researchers can inspect, run themselves and build on.
:::
::: {.q-card .big}
[Open data with ease]{.q-h}
From the field to a citable data package in a few clicks: codebook, SPSS, jamovi, R, Zenodo.
:::
::: {.q-card .big}
[Reuse through the toolbox]{.q-h}
Validated scales go in as ordinary items; every study adds to their pooled reliability.
:::
::: {.q-card .big .ai}
[AI where it suits]{.q-h}
Suggestions, never decisions: clearly labelled, reviewed by the researcher, switchable.
:::
:::

## From idea to field

::: columns
::: {.column .q-side width="44%"}
- **Likert and semantic differential scales**, validated instruments from the toolbox
- **38 item types**, incl. CBC, ACBC and MaxDiff with AI product images and hierarchical Bayes
- **Loops over a table** and **D-optimal vignette** designs
- Blocks, branches, piping, quotas, panel links, links per group
- **Live feedback** to participants: their position compared with the sample
- Preview on desktop and smartphone, with comment fields
:::
::: {.column width="56%"}
![](img/cj-ai-task.jpg){.q-shot .tall fig-alt="Choice task with two AI-generated care robots"}
:::
:::

::: q-refs
Brauner (2024), Frontiers in Psychology · Kühne & Kroh (2018), Social Science Computer Review
:::

## Results you can share

::: columns
::: {.column .q-side width="34%"}
- **Live**: M, SD, median, **Cronbach's α** and **McDonald's ω** with intervals
- Results per hypothesis of the study plan
- **Quality control**: speeders, straightlining, attention checks, bots
- **Open data**: SPSS, jamovi, R, codebook, Zenodo; draft of the methods section
:::
::: {.column width="66%"}
![](img/results-scales.jpg){.q-shot fig-alt="Scales overview with alpha, omega and correlations"}
:::
:::

::: q-refs
Leiner (2019), Survey Research Methods · Hayes & Coutts (2020), Communication Methods and Measures
:::

## Beyond the questionnaire {.center}

::: {.q-grid style="--cols: 3;"}

Live feedback at lectures and events, steered by the presenter.
:::
